page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-192-standardlssd is a virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 192 dedicated vCPUs and 1512.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates without integrated graphics processing units, having a GPU count of zero.

Although designated as a storage-optimized virtual machine in its family classification, the local storage size is specified as none. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Performance benchmark data, including CPU, memory bandwidth, and database operations, is currently unavailable for this specific instance type.

Given the high resource density of 192 dedicated vCPUs and over 1.5 TB of RAM, this server type is structured for large-scale enterprise workloads. The high memory-to-CPU ratio makes it suitable for memory-intensive applications, large database deployments, and heavy data processing tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the massive allocation of dedicated compute and memory resources positions this instance in the high-end hardware class, designed to support consolidated workloads that require substantial memory capacity without the need for GPU acceleration.
